source: East London Mosque, published London Unified Prayer Timetable for 2026 (eastlondonmosque.org.uk/prayer-times), retrieved 2026-07-28.

method.sunrise: His Majesty's Nautical Almanac Office, minus 3 minutes for safety across the M25 region.
method.zuhr: HMNAO solar transit, plus 5 minutes to ensure the sun has cleared its zenith.
method.asr: HMNAO. Mithl 1 is the non-Hanafi shadow length, Mithl 2 the Hanafi one.
method.maghrib: HMNAO sunset, plus 3 minutes for safety across the M25 region.
method.fajrAndIsha: Based on the work of Hizbul Ulama. NOT a sun-depression angle, and so not reproducible by any calculation method, madhhab or high-latitude rule. Recorded here as observed values only.
